gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-pontano-sans: Light, open-mouthed letters make the text feel easygoing and modern, with barely any swell in the line. Pontano Sans keeps that softness under Red Hat Display, whose marker-like bold strokes are the pair's loudest, clearest quality.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans reads friendly and straightforward, its c forms drawn as open arcs and its line hardly varying in thickness. Under Red Hat Display, paragraphs would feel easy to settle into.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-quattrocento-s: Gaps that keep c from collapsing into o give this text a modern, clean look beside the marker-bold Red Hat Display. Quattrocento Sans stays light on the eye across a full page, its line barely modulating.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-red-hat-text: Red Hat Text draws in a technical-pen line, curvy and unclamped, while Red Hat Display up top goes bold. Red Hat Text keeps paragraphs approachable, its rounded letters loosening the whole block.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans reads plain and steady, with a wide gap in its e. Line after line, its strokes hold one thickness in every direction, a quiet counterpoint to the bold Red Hat Display.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-roboto-flex: Tube-bold up top, friendly below: Red Hat Display holds a constant-width stroke while Roboto Flex barely varies. And the wide slot in the sans body's c keeps text approachable beneath that heavy heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-rosario: Rosario lets the ends of its c never curl inward, giving this sans-serif text an approachable feel. Rosario holds a paragraph gently next to Red Hat Display, whose round letters carry walls matching its straight ones.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ruluko: Ruluko gives every c and s a broad open counter, which makes the text feel approachable and clean. Ruluko carries paragraphs lightly under Red Hat Display, which has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sansation: Red Hat Display is built from marker-like strokes, with counters framed by same-width lines, and it comes across bold. Display hits hard; Sansation turns its curves smoothly, with no ink pooling.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sarabun: Thread-like curves on top: Red Hat Display holds a constant line, while Sarabun opens a wide channel into every bowl. And that plain sans text stays clean and approachable under the heavier heading.
